name: System X
goal: Domain knowledge ingestion, contextual gap detection, proactive highlighting, reactive querying, knowledge curation, provenance navigation, and human-directed narrative revision.
description: the system is a mixed-initiative writing environment that proactively identifies potential domain knowledge gaps in fiction drafts and provides source-grounded explanations and facts. Writers can query unfamiliar concepts, organize retrieved knowledge on a spatial canvas, and incorporate it into their own prose. Actors: model_1 = language model; model_2 = embedding model; tool_1 = graph database; tool_2 = asynchronous context management component; tool_3 = source alignment and presentation component.

processes.name: Build Domain Knowledge Graph
processes.description: The author uploads reference books or other domain texts. The system extracts entities and relationships, associates them with their original source passages, and stores the resulting knowledge graph in tool_1.
processes.rawExpression:
(source_documents_1: artifact language)*
-> [model_1 extract]
-> (domain_entities_1: artifact record)* + (domain_relations_1: artifact record)*
-> [tool_1 compose]
-> (knowledge_graph_1: artifact graph)

processes.name: Maintain Writing Context
processes.description: During drafting, tool_2 asynchronously combines the current prose with the Knowledge Canvas topology to maintain a Semantic Frame that informs knowledge retrieval.
processes.rawExpression:
(draft_1: artifact language) + (canvas_1: artifact graph)
-> [tool_2 compose]
-> (semantic_frame_1: artifact record)

processes.name: Proactively Highlight Knowledge Gaps
processes.description: As the author writes, model_1 extracts domain concepts from the current context, model_2 embeds them, and the graph retriever finds related source-backed knowledge. tool_3 selects relevant phrases in the draft as potential knowledge gaps, displaying subtle inline highlights after a five-second typing pause.
processes.rawExpression:
(draft_1: artifact language) + (semantic_frame_1: artifact record) + (knowledge_graph_1: artifact graph)
-> [model_1 extract]
-> (draft_concepts_1: artifact record)* + (draft_1: artifact language) + (knowledge_graph_1: artifact graph)
-> [model_2 translate]
-> (concept_vectors_1: artifact numeric)* + (draft_1: artifact language) + (knowledge_graph_1: artifact graph)
-> [tool_1 match]
-> (candidate_facts_1: artifact record)* + (draft_1: artifact language)
-> [tool_3 select]
-> (highlight_spans_1: selection language)* + (candidate_facts_1: artifact record)* + (draft_1: artifact language)

processes.name: Inspect Highlighted Knowledge
processes.description: When the author clicks a highlighted phrase, the system opens a contextual Knowledge Card. The card pairs an AI-generated explanation of the domain concept with an exact passage from the uploaded source material.
processes.rawExpression:
(highlight_spans_1: selection language)* + (candidate_facts_1: artifact record)* + (draft_1: artifact language)
-> [human select]
-> (clicked_span_1: selection language) + (candidate_facts_1: artifact record)*
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (card_explanation_1: artifact language) + (clicked_span_1: selection language) + (candidate_facts_1: artifact record)*
-> [tool_3 compose]
-> (highlight_card_1: artifact record)

processes.name: Query Domain Knowledge
processes.description: The author asks a question in the Query Panel. model_1 extracts relevant concepts, model_2 provides embeddings, and multi-hop graph retrieval finds source-backed facts. Two parallel instances of tool_3 produce a conversational response and structured Knowledge Cards, with semantic matching connecting corresponding concepts through color-coded highlights.
processes.rawExpression:
(semantic_frame_1: artifact record) + (knowledge_graph_1: artifact graph)
-> [human specify]
-> (query_1: instruction language) + (semantic_frame_1: artifact record) + (knowledge_graph_1: artifact graph)
-> [model_1 extract]
-> (query_concepts_1: artifact record)* + (query_1: instruction language) + (knowledge_graph_1: artifact graph)
-> [model_2 translate]
-> (query_vectors_1: artifact numeric)* + (query_1: instruction language) + (knowledge_graph_1: artifact graph)
-> [tool_1 match]
-> (query_facts_1: artifact record)* + (query_1: instruction language)
-> [model_1 generate]~
-> (query_answer_1: artifact language) + (query_facts_1: artifact record)*
-> [tool_3 compose]
-> (query_answer_1: artifact language) + (query_cards_1: artifact record)*
-> [tool_3 match]
-> (query_answer_1: artifact language) + (query_cards_1: artifact record)* + (text_card_links_1: artifact record)*

processes.name: Curate Knowledge on Canvas
processes.description: After discovering facts through highlights or queries, the author adds selected Knowledge Cards to the spatial canvas. Cards from highlights become gold nodes and cards from queries become silver nodes; the system automatically identifies and displays labeled semantic connections between related nodes.
processes.rawExpression:
(canvas_1: artifact graph) + (highlight_card_1: artifact record) + (query_cards_1: artifact record)*
-> [human select]
-> (canvas_1: artifact graph) + (chosen_highlight_card_1: selection record) + (chosen_query_card_1: selection record)
-> [tool_3 compose]
-> (canvas_2: artifact graph)
-> [tool_1 match]
-> (canvas_2: artifact graph) + (related_edges_1: artifact graph)
-> [tool_3 compose]
-> (canvas_3: artifact graph)

processes.name: Navigate to Highlight Source
processes.description: When the author clicks a gold node on the Knowledge Canvas, the system locates and visually highlights the original passage in the draft that triggered the associated knowledge discovery.
processes.rawExpression:
(canvas_3: artifact graph) + (draft_1: artifact language)
-> [human select]
-> (gold_node_1: selection record) + (canvas_3: artifact graph) + (draft_1: artifact language)
-> [tool_3 match]
-> (origin_span_1: selection language) + (draft_1: artifact language)

processes.name: Navigate to Query Source
processes.description: When the author clicks a silver node on the Knowledge Canvas, the system follows its stored provenance link and scrolls the Query Panel to the conversation turn from which that knowledge originated.
processes.rawExpression:
(canvas_3: artifact graph) + (query_answer_1: artifact language)
-> [human select]
-> (silver_node_1: selection record) + (canvas_3: artifact graph) + (query_answer_1: artifact language)
-> [tool_3 match]
-> (query_turn_1: selection language) + (query_answer_1: artifact language)

processes.name: Integrate Knowledge into Narrative
processes.description: The author uses discovered and organized domain knowledge to revise or continue the narrative in their own words, without AI-generated story prose. tool_2 updates the Semantic Frame with the revised draft and curated canvas so later discovery reflects the evolving writing context.
processes.rawExpression:
(draft_1: artifact language) + (canvas_3: artifact graph)
-> [human modify]
-> (draft_2: artifact language) + (canvas_3: artifact graph)
-> [tool_2 compose]
-> (semantic_frame_2: artifact record) + (draft_2: artifact language) + (canvas_3: artifact graph)

representations.source_documents: reference books or other domain texts the author uploads
representations.domain_entities: entities extracted from the source documents, each tied to the passage it came from
representations.domain_relations: relationships between extracted entities, each tied to the passage it came from
representations.knowledge_graph: the stored graph of entities and relations with links to their source passages
representations.draft: the fiction text the author is writing
representations.canvas: a spatial canvas of saved knowledge cards as nodes, with labeled connections between related nodes
representations.semantic_frame: a summary of the current writing context, built from the draft and the canvas, used to guide retrieval
representations.draft_concepts: domain concepts found in the current draft
representations.candidate_facts: source-backed facts from the graph that relate to the draft concepts
representations.highlight_spans: phrases in the draft marked inline as possible knowledge gaps
representations.clicked_span: the highlighted phrase the author clicks
representations.card_explanation: a short generated explanation of the concept in the clicked phrase
representations.highlight_card: a knowledge card pairing the explanation with an exact passage from the source material
representations.query: a question the author asks in the query panel
representations.query_facts: source-backed facts retrieved from the graph for the question
representations.query_answer: a conversational answer to the question
representations.query_cards: structured knowledge cards for the retrieved facts, each with its source passage
representations.text_card_links: links between concepts in the answer and the matching cards, shown with shared colors
representations.chosen_highlight_card: a card from a highlight that the author saves to the canvas
representations.chosen_query_card: a card from a query that the author saves to the canvas
representations.related_edges: labeled connections found between related canvas nodes
representations.gold_node: a canvas node that came from an inline highlight
representations.silver_node: a canvas node that came from a query
representations.origin_span: the passage in the draft that led to a gold node
representations.query_turn: the conversation turn in the query panel that led to a silver node
